end.summary:
Practised place value for 4-digit numbers up to 9999.
Used 3456 to identify the thousands, hundreds, tens and ones places.
Diya initially treated 4 as only 4 and 5 as only 5, without place value.
They later represented 42 as 40 + 2 using groups of 10; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers through place-value boxes and groups of 10. Diya identified the positions in 3456 and later corrected the tens-place mix-up by explaining 42 as 40 + 2. At home, practise a few numbers such as 2,406 or 3,572 by saying each digit’s place and value aloud.
